title: Only what the record states.
Not "is a" facts.
Not opinions.
Not negated facts.
Not facts the record doesn't assert as true:
Not the values inside a data table; only what the table is about.
Not a fact without a specific thing.
Not words that are true only as of when the record was written.
The subject instance is what the sentence is about
One fact per ground truth triple.
Each fact once,
A number with a unit: the object instance is the number and its unit, as written; what the number measures goes in the predicate.

A qualifier that is a temporal resolution, an area the data cover, a processing level, a spatial resolution, a country, a time of day, or a target body is a ground truth triple of its own, and is taken out of the instance.
A name with its own abbreviation, another name or code of its own, or a short note in parentheses is one instance, as written.
General facts: include them; about another dataset, only when the record links it to the record's dataset by "part of" or "made from".
A list: one ground truth triple per item.
One thing, one wording, within a record.
A processing step: output = method(input).
